rationale: The plan correctly identifies the interaction as the condition:time term and runs the DESeq2 LRT of full ~condition+time+condition:time vs reduced ~condition+time, with explicit reference levels, per-coefficient and simple-effect Wald reporting, and an edgeR QL robustness check — a strong, design-specific match. QC precedes testing with PCA/VST/distance heatmap/library sizes colored by condition and shaped by time, with an explicit no-drop-but-flag policy given n=3; only minor deduction since no batch exists to color by. Filtering (10 counts in ≥3 samples) is minimal and justified, normalization is done inside the model (DESeq2 size factors, TMM in edgeR) with no pre-scaling. BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage, and thresholding strictly on padj are all explicit and well justified. Enrichment is warranted and thoroughly specified with full ranked list, stated LRT ranking metric, universe, size window, collection naming/version, and Reactome-substitution caveat. The final report is comprehensive, naming methods, versions, design, thresholds, counts, power caveats, and reproducibility record.
